head1: Two myths from this week's news.
head2: One is about your Google rankings.

items.myth: Reposting a viral clip is free reach.
items.fact: Instagram now flags reposts, even AI-edited ones, and can credit the original creator.

items.myth: A Google core update means rewrite your site this week.
items.fact: Google says wait until the update finishes, then compare a full week of data.

cta: Send this to whoever runs your social.

vo.outro: Send this to whoever runs your social. Two myths, two easy fixes: post your own work, and wait out the update.
